terms.gloss: the heavy javelin of the Roman legionary
terms.comment: First a pestle (Cato); then the legionary’s javelin, hurled before the fight with swords (Lewis & Short). The ī is long: not pila, a ball, nor pilus, a hair.

terms.gloss: a dart, a javelin; anything thrown
terms.comment: The general word, from jaciō, to throw.

phrases.latin: mīlitēs ē locō superiōre pīlīs missīs facile hostium phalangem perfrēgērunt
phrases.english: the soldiers threw their javelins from the higher ground and easily broke the enemy’s phalanx

sources: Lewis & Short: pilum · Lewis & Short: jaculum
